en.question: Suppose a <<10345>> is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, then banished from the Graveyard by <<6980>>, but then returned to the Graveyard by <<6941>>. Is it possible to activate the effect of <<10345>> during the next Standby Phase to Special Summon it from the Graveyard? Additionally, if <<10345>> is destroyed and banished by <<5400>>, but then returned to the Graveyard by <<6941>>, is it possible to activate the effect of <<10345>> during the next Standby Phase to Special Summon it from the Graveyard?

ja.question:

その後、「<<6941>>」の効果によって墓地へ戻っている場合、次のスタンバイフェイズに、その「<<10345>>」の効果を発動する事はできますか？
